options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: Death Link Amnesty
options.doc:
Amount of forgiven deaths before sending a Death Link.
0 means that every death will send a Death Link.

options.name: Death Wish Amnesty
options.doc: Amount of forgiven deaths before sending a Death Link during Death Wish levels.

options.name: End Goal
options.doc:
The end goal required to beat the game.
Finale: Reach Time's End and beat Mustache Girl. The Finale will be in its vanilla location.

Rush Hour: Reach and complete Rush Hour. The level will be in its vanilla location and Chapter 7
will be the final chapter. You also must find Nyakuza Metro itself and complete all of its levels.
Requires DLC2 content to be enabled.

Seal the Deal: Reach and complete the Seal the Deal death wish main objective.
Requires Death Wish content to be enabled.

options.name: Shuffle Storybook Pages
options.doc:
If enabled, each storybook page in the purple Time Rifts is an item check.
The Compass Badge can track these down for you.

options.name: Shuffle Director Tokens
options.doc:
If enabled, causes the Conductor/DJ Grooves tokens found in Chapter 2 levels to become item checks.
NOTE: This also includes the time bonus pickups from Train Rush, since the level doesn't have any tokens.

options.name: Shuffle Alpine Ziplines
options.doc: If enabled, Alpine's zipline paths leading to the peaks will be locked behind items.

options.name: Shuffle Subcon Paintings
options.doc:
If enabled, shuffle items into the pool that unlock Subcon Forest fire spirit paintings.
These items are progressive, with the order of Village-Swamp-Courtyard.

options.name: Shuffle Contracts
options.doc: If enabled, shuffle Snatcher's act contracts into the pool as items

options.name: Minimum Shop Pon Cost
options.doc: The minimum number of Pons that any item in the Badge Seller's shop can cost.

options.name: Maximum Shop Pon Cost
options.doc: The maximum number of Pons that any item in the Badge Seller's shop can cost.

options.name: Badge Seller Minimum Items
options.doc: The smallest number of items that the Badge Seller can have for sale.

options.name: Badge Seller Maximum Items
options.doc: The largest number of items that the Badge Seller can have for sale.

options.name: Logic Difficulty
options.doc:
Choose the difficulty setting for logic.
For an exhaustive list of all logic tricks for each difficulty, see this Google Doc:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1x9VLSQ5davfx1KGamR9T0mD5h69_lDXJ6H7Gq7knJRI/edit?usp=sharing

options.name: No Subcon Fire Wall Skips
options.doc: If enabled, prevent Subcon fire wall skips from being in logic on higher difficulty settings.

options.name: Cheating the Race Logic
options.doc: Choose how you want to logically clear Cheating the Race.

options.name: Shuffle Acts
options.doc:
If enabled, shuffle the game's Acts between each other.
Light will cause Time Rifts to only be shuffled amongst each other,
and Blue Time Rifts and Purple Time Rifts to be shuffled separately.

options.name: Starting Chapter
options.doc: Determines which chapter you will be guaranteed to be able to enter at the beginning of the game.

options.name: Lowest Possible Chapter Cost
options.doc:
Value determining the lowest possible cost for a chapter.
Chapter costs will, progressively, be calculated based on this value (except for the final chapter).

options.name: Highest Possible Chapter Cost
options.doc:
Value determining the highest possible cost for a chapter.
Chapter costs will, progressively, be calculated based on this value (except for the final chapter).

options.name: Chapter Cost Increment
options.doc: Lower values mean chapter costs increase slower. Higher values make the cost differences more steep.

options.name: Minimum Chapter Cost Difference
options.doc: The minimum difference between chapter costs.

options.name: Final Chapter Minimum Time Piece Cost
options.doc: Minimum Time Pieces required to enter the final chapter. This is part of your goal.

options.name: Final Chapter Maximum Time Piece Cost
options.doc: Maximum Time Pieces required to enter the final chapter. This is part of your goal.

options.name: Finale Shuffle
options.doc: If enabled, chapter finales will only be shuffled amongst each other in act shuffle.

options.name: Act Plando
options.doc:
Plando acts onto other acts. For example, "Train Rush": "Alpine Free Roam" will place Alpine Free Roam
at Train Rush.

options.name: Act Blacklist
options.doc:
Blacklist acts from being shuffled onto other acts. Multiple can be listed per act.
For example, "Barrel Battle": ["The Big Parade", "Dead Bird Studio"]
will prevent The Big Parade and Dead Bird Studio from being shuffled onto Barrel Battle.

options.name: Start with Compass Badge
options.doc:
If enabled, start with the Compass Badge. In Archipelago, the Compass Badge will track all items in the world
(instead of just Relics). Recommended if you're not familiar with where item locations are.

options.name: Compass Badge Mode
options.doc:
closest - Compass Badge points to the closest item regardless of classification
important_only - Compass Badge points to progression/useful items only
important_first - Compass Badge points to progression/useful items first, then it will point to junk items

options.name: Randomize Hat Order
options.doc:
Randomize the order that hats are stitched in.
Time Stop Last will force Time Stop to be the last hat in the sequence.

options.name: Yarn Available
options.doc: How much yarn is available to collect in the item pool.

options.name: Minimum Yarn Cost
options.doc: The minimum possible yarn needed to stitch a hat.

options.name: Maximum Yarn Cost
options.doc: The maximum possible yarn needed to stitch a hat.

options.name: Min Extra Yarn
options.doc:
The minimum number of extra yarn in the item pool.
There must be at least this much more yarn over the total number of yarn needed to craft all hats.
For example, if this option's value is 10, and the total yarn needed to craft all hats is 40,
there must be at least 50 yarn in the pool.

options.name: Hat Items
options.doc: Removes all yarn from the pool and turns the hats into individual items instead.

options.name: Umbrella Logic
options.doc: Makes Hat Kid's default punch attack do absolutely nothing, making the Umbrella much more relevant and useful

options.name: Max Extra Time Pieces
options.doc:
Maximum number of extra Time Pieces from the DLCs.
Arctic Cruise will add up to 6. Nyakuza Metro will add up to 10. The absolute maximum is 56.

options.name: Yarn Balance Percentage
options.doc: How much (in percentage) of the yarn in the pool that will be progression balanced.

options.name: Time Piece Balance Percentage
options.doc: How much (in percentage) of time pieces in the pool that will be progression balanced.

options.name: Shuffle Chapter 6
options.doc:
Shuffle content from The Arctic Cruise (Chapter 6) into the game. This also includes the Tour time rift.
DO NOT ENABLE THIS OPTION IF YOU DO NOT HAVE SEAL THE DEAL DLC INSTALLED!!!

options.name: Tasksanity
options.doc: If enabled, Ship Shape tasks will become checks. Requires DLC1 content to be enabled.

options.name: Tasksanity Task Step
options.doc: How many tasks the player must complete in Tasksanity to send a check.

options.name: Tasksanity Check Count
options.doc: How many Tasksanity checks there will be in total.

options.name: Ship Shape Custom Task Goal
options.doc:
Change the number of tasks required to complete Ship Shape. If this option's value is 0, the number of tasks
required will be TasksanityTaskStep x TasksanityCheckCount, if Tasksanity is enabled. If Tasksanity is disabled,
it will use the game's default of 18.
This option will not affect Cruisin' for a Bruisin'.

options.name: Exclude Tour Time Rift
options.doc:
Removes the Tour time rift from the game. This option is recommended if you don't want to deal with
important levels being shuffled onto the Tour time rift, or important items being shuffled onto Tour pages
when your goal is Time's End.

options.name: Shuffle Chapter 7
options.doc:
Shuffle content from Nyakuza Metro (Chapter 7) into the game.
DO NOT ENABLE THIS OPTION IF YOU DO NOT HAVE NYAKUZA METRO DLC INSTALLED!!!

options.name: Metro Shops Minimum Pon Cost
options.doc: The cheapest an item can be in any Nyakuza Metro shop. Includes ticket booths.

options.name: Metro Shops Maximum Pon Cost
options.doc: The most expensive an item can be in any Nyakuza Metro shop. Includes ticket booths.

options.name: Nyakuza Thug Minimum Shop Items
options.doc: The smallest number of items that the thugs in Nyakuza Metro can have for sale.

options.name: Nyakuza Thug Maximum Shop Items
options.doc: The largest number of items that the thugs in Nyakuza Metro can have for sale.

options.name: Baseball Bat
options.doc:
Replace the Umbrella with the baseball bat from Nyakuza Metro.
DLC2 content does not have to be shuffled for this option but Nyakuza Metro still needs to be installed.

options.name: No Ticket Skips
options.doc:
Prevent metro gate skips from being in logic on higher difficulties.
Rush Hour option will only consider the ticket skips for Rush Hour in logic.

options.name: Enable Death Wish
options.doc:
Shuffle Death Wish contracts into the game. Each contract by default will have 1 check granted upon completion.
DO NOT ENABLE THIS OPTION IF YOU DO NOT HAVE SEAL THE DEAL DLC INSTALLED!!!

options.name: Death Wish Time Piece Requirement
options.doc: How many Time Pieces that will be required to unlock Death Wish.

options.name: Death Wish Shuffle
options.doc:
An alternative mode for Death Wish where each contract is unlocked one by one, in a random order.
Stamp requirements to unlock contracts is removed. Any excluded contracts will not be shuffled into the sequence.
If Seal the Deal is the end goal, it will always be the last Death Wish in the sequence.
Disabling candles is highly recommended.

options.name: Death Wish Shuffle Minimum Count
options.doc:
The minimum number of Death Wishes that can be in the Death Wish shuffle sequence.
The final result is clamped at the number of non-excluded Death Wishes.

options.name: Death Wish Shuffle Maximum Count
options.doc:
The maximum number of Death Wishes that can be in the Death Wish shuffle sequence.
The final result is clamped at the number of non-excluded Death Wishes.

options.name: Shuffle Death Wish Full Completions
options.doc:
In Death Wish, add a location for completing all of a DW contract's bonuses,
in addition to the location for completing the DW contract normally.
WARNING!! Only for the brave! This option can create VERY DIFFICULT SEEDS!
ONLY turn this on if you know what you are doing to yourself and everyone else in the multiworld!
Using Peace and Tranquility to auto-complete the bonuses will NOT count!

options.name: Auto Complete Bonus Stamps
options.doc:
If enabled, auto complete all bonus stamps after completing the main objective in a Death Wish.
This option will have no effect if bonus checks (DWEnableBonus) are turned on.

options.name: Exclude Annoying Death Wish Contracts
options.doc:
Exclude Death Wish contracts from the pool that are particularly tedious or take a long time to reach/clear.
Excluded Death Wishes are automatically completed as soon as they are unlocked.
This option currently excludes the following contracts:
- Vault Codes in the Wind
- Boss Rush
- Camera Tourist
- The Mustache Gauntlet
- Rift Collapse: Deep Sea
- Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
- Seal the Deal (non-excluded if goal, but the checks are still excluded)

options.name: Exclude Annoying Death Wish Full Completions
options.doc:
If Death Wish full completions are shuffled in, exclude tedious Death Wish full completions from the pool.
Excluded bonus Death Wishes automatically reward their bonus stamps upon completion of the main objective.
This option currently excludes the following bonuses:
- So You're Back From Outer Space
- Encore! Encore!
- Snatcher's Hit List
- 10 Seconds until Self-Destruct
- Killing Two Birds
- Zero Jumps
- Bird Sanctuary
- Wound-Up Windmill
- Vault Codes in the Wind
- Boss Rush
- Camera Tourist
- The Mustache Gauntlet
- Rift Collapse: Deep Sea
- Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
- Seal the Deal

options.name: Exclude Candle Death Wishes
options.doc: If enabled, exclude all candle Death Wishes.

options.name: Death Wish Only
options.doc:
An alternative gameplay mode that allows you to exclusively play Death Wish in a seed.
This has the following effects:
- Death Wish is instantly unlocked from the start
- All hats and other progression items are instantly given to you
- Useful items such as Fast Hatter Badge will still be in the item pool instead of in your inventory at the start
- All chapters and their levels are unlocked, act shuffle is forced off
- Any checks other than Death Wish contracts are completely removed
- All Pons in the item pool are replaced with Health Pons or random cosmetics
- The EndGoal option is forced to complete Seal the Deal

options.name: Trap Chance
options.doc: The chance for any junk item in the pool to be replaced by a trap.

options.name: Baby Trap Weight
options.doc:
The weight of Baby Traps in the trap pool.
Baby Traps place a multitude of the Conductor's grandkids into Hat Kid's hands, causing her to lose her balance.

options.name: Laser Trap Weight
options.doc:
The weight of Laser Traps in the trap pool.
Laser Traps will spawn multiple giant lasers (from Snatcher's boss fight) at Hat Kid's location.

options.name: Parade Trap Weight
options.doc:
The weight of Parade Traps in the trap pool.
Parade Traps will summon multiple Express Band owls with knives that chase Hat Kid by mimicking her movement.

options.name: Local Items
options.doc: Forces these items to be in their native world.
options.doc_html: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: Non-local Items
options.doc: Forces these items to be outside their native world.
options.doc_html: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: Start Inventory
options.doc: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}
options.doc_html: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

options.name: Start Inventory from Pool
options.doc:
Start with the specified amount of these items and don't place them in the world. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

The game decides what the replacement items will be.
options.doc_html:
Start with the specified amount of these items and don't place them in the world. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

The game decides what the replacement items will be.

options.name: Start Hints
options.doc: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the !hint command.

options.name: Start Location Hints
options.doc: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the !hint command.

options.name: Excluded Locations
options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an important item.
options.doc_html: Prevent these locations from having an important item.

options.name: Priority Locations
options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.
options.doc_html: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.

options.name: Item Links
options.doc: Share part of your item pool with other players.
options.doc_html: Share part of your item pool with other players.
